copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 调用 Mistral AI 的各类 API 能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 TypeScript 集成 Mistral AI 的聊天、嵌入或视觉功能
copy.tagline_en: Call Mistral AI APIs with TypeScript for chat, embeddings, vision, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are integrating Mistral AI's chat, embeddings, or vision capabilities in TypeScript

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你生成调用 Mistral AI 模型的 TypeScript 代码，包括聊天、流式输出、结构化数据提取、函数调用、嵌入、图像分析和代码补全。
howto.when: 当你提到 Mistral、mistral、@mistralai/mistralai 等关键词，或要求编写 Mistral SDK 代码时触发。

say.text: 用 Mistral SDK 写一个聊天补全示例。
帮我用 Zod 做结构化输出。
写一个 Codestral FIM 代码补全。
say.note: Claude 会使用 fim.complete() 端点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you generate TypeScript code to call Mistral AI models, including chat completions, streaming, structured outputs, function calling, embeddings, vision, and Codestral FIM.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like Mistral, mistral, @mistralai/mistralai, or ask to write Mistral SDK code.

say_en.text: Write a chat completion example using Mistral SDK.
Help me do structured output with Zod.
say_en.note: Claude will use chat.parse() with a Zod schema.

say_en.text: Write a Codestral FIM code completion.
say_en.note: Claude will use the fim.complete() endpoint.
